title: Maximise Brand Visibility. Strengthen Industry Presence. Build Strategic Partnerships.
introParagraphs: BUILDIQ offers a range of sponsorship and partnership opportunities for organisations seeking to enhance brand visibility, demonstrate technological leadership and engage with key stakeholders across the smart building and intelligent infrastructure ecosystem.

As a focused B2B industry platform, BUILDIQ provides sponsors with opportunities to connect with developers, architects, consultants, contractors, system integrators, facility managers, technology professionals and prospective business partners.
closingNote: BUILDIQ welcomes technology brands, industry leaders, manufacturers, service providers and organisations interested in building meaningful industry associations. All sponsorship benefits, branding inventory and deliverables will be subject to the approved sponsorship proposal and availability.
